name: anatomy_monster_archunk_strong_022

source_visual_profile.source_description: This formless, pitch-black mass wriggles violently and noisily on the ground as it reshapes itself before your eyes.  It slowly drags itself towards you with many tendrils of varied sizes sparkling with electricity.  As it gets closer to you, its wriggling intensifies and its sparks grow brighter as if it reacted to you.
